_comment: roi/exclude_roi are [[x,y],...] polygons in 1920x1080 space. Detection ignores 'vehicle' (the BBQ trips it). null rtsp_camera_direct / email.to are filled in from local.env (see h32env.py). Email: set enabled=true and fill detector/secrets.json (copy secrets.json.example).
_comment_scenery: Static garden furniture reads as a low-confidence person to MegaDetector — that is what produced 56 bogus PERSON events on 2026-08-16. See scenery.py. min_move is how far a box must travel (as a fraction of its own size) before it counts as alive: raise it if furniture still gets through, lower it if slow animals are missed. static_after_secs is how long a never-moving spot must keep flickering before it is written off as scenery; conf_certain is the confidence at which a detection is believed regardless. Learned spots live in detector/scenery.json — delete that file to forget them.
_comment_signal: signal_timeout_secs: no frame for this long and the monitor says NO CAMERA SIGNAL, detection pauses and no events fire (rather than sitting on the last frame with a ticking clock).
